title: Sources & further reading
body:
Official and operator sources: Matsue Castle, Izumo Taisha, Oda City tourism / Iwami Ginzan, Iwami Ginzan World Heritage Center, Ichibata Electric Railway, JR West, Izumo Airport, Shimane Prefecture tourism (Japanese), Tanabe Museum of Art, and the Japan Meteorological Agency for climate normals.

A second, independent native-language research effort corroborated the core picks and added local/resident sources — jimohack.shimane.jp, na-na.media, and Japanese-language visitor blogs — for crowd-timing and reservation-friction detail that English-language coverage didn't surface; see the guide's research ledger for the full reconciliation trail.

Entry/visa requirements and the current US travel advisory could not be confirmed against their official pages (both blocked non-browser fetches) — re-check mofa.go.jp and travel.state.gov directly before booking.
